title: arya-singh-soc2-evidence-daily-scratchpad
content:
Daily scratchpad for SOC2 evidence tasks - quick hit list, notes, and reminders.

(11/05/2025) Top priorities:
- [ ] Finalize encryption-at-rest evidence bundle for KMS integration (customer-private deployment). Owner: Arya. Due: 2025-11-10. Related: SEC-112.
- [ ] Vendor review: KeyVaultCo (HSM provider) — confirm SOC2 report + AICPA bridge letter. Owner: Priya. Due: 2025-11-07.
- [x] Upload access control matrix snapshot (IAM roles) for dev/prod clusters — done 11/04, file attached to Confluence.
- [ ] Draft control narrative for CC6: Logical Access Controls — aim for first pass by EOD 11/06.

Notes / quick captures:
- Meeting w/ infra (11/04): discussed timeline for Dedicated customers -> need explicit evidence of dedicated tenant separation (network diagrams + routing ACLs). Action: ask infra for latest diagrams.
- Evidence checklist format: prefer single zip per control with: narrative.txt, screenshots (redwood-iam-*), logs-export.csv (last 90d), config-diff.txt.
- For KMS evidence: include key rotation policy, rotation logs, KMS config export (region, key-id, key-type).

Vendor review: KeyVaultCo
- Items to collect:
  - SOC2 Type II report (last 12 months)
  - Bridge letter (if report older than 12 months)
  - Encryption architecture diagram showing HSM integration
  - Subprocessor list and subprocessors' controls (if they subcontract)
- Quick status: Priya requested report 11/03, vendor replied 11/04 saying report available but need NDA to share. Follow-up: send standard redwood vendor NDA + ask for AICPA bridge letter.

Evidence mapping (working):
- CC5 (Monitoring): logs-export.csv from central logging -> shows retention + alerting config (owner: Samira).
- CC6 (Access): iam-matrix-snapshot + last 30 days access-review notes.
- CC7 (Change mgmt): release-engineering PRs + approval trail for runtime changes; link to GH PRs.

Jira/Confluence reminders:
- Add ticket link SEC-215 to every evidence bundle.
- Confluence page: /display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Index — update index with newest zip by 11/08.

Prompt ideas for docs (for later):
- Short control narrative template (3 paragraphs): scope, control activities, monitoring evidence.
- Quick README for auditors: one-pager summarizing what’s in each evidence zip.

Open questions / blockers:
- Do we need signed BAA for KeyVaultCo? (legal check) -> loop in Legal: Jordan (cc Priya).
- Infra to confirm whether Dedicated networks use separate VPCs or shared VPC with strict tagging. Need answer for control scoping.

Quick todo (today):
- [ ] Email infra for current network diagram (ask for editable .drawio) — target: today
- [ ] Pull last 90 days of rotation logs from KMS (query: rotate_events >= 2025-08-01)
- [ ] Draft CC6 narrative skeleton and post to Confluence as draft page
- [ ] Add vendor NDA to drive and label "vendor-keyvaultco-nda-draft"

Snippets to paste in tickets / Confluence:
- "Evidence bundle includes: narrative.txt, screenshots/, logs-export.csv, config-diff.txt. Contact: arya.singh@redwood.com"
- "Control owner: Security & Compliance (Arya Singh). Evidence retention: 12 months for audit-scope unless otherwise specified."

Meeting notes (11/03 quick sync):
- Legal: recommended asking for AICPA bridge letter if vendor report is >12 months.
- Infra: can export network ACLs in CSV but need 24 hours to produce canonical diagrams.

Attachments / local files to upload later:
- iam-matrix-snapshot-2025-11-04.csv
- kms-rotation-export-2025-11-05.csv
- network-diagram-draft.drawio (requested)

Random reminders to self:
- Keep evidence filenames consistent: controlid_evidence-type_date.zip (eg CC6_access_20251105.zip)
- Save a copy of each upload to /shared_drives/security-and-compliance/audit-uploads/ for team visibility.

End of scratchpad entry. Will update after vendor response / infra diagrams arrive.

References:
- SEC Jira board: SEC-100..SEC-220 (filter: label:soc2-evidence)
- Confluence index (working): https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/SEC/SOC2+Evidence+Index

(quick log) 11/05 09:12 — emailed infra; 11:20 — Priya confirmed NDA sent to vendor.
